programization_effect: Corrections changed exact ordering and improved the 2021 confirmed diagnostic, but did not alter the unchanged 2022 forward failure.
logic_diagnosis: Pairing opposite prior-day boundaries represents scale, but a one-sided raid/reclaim is not direct evidence that institutional inventory was secured.
A genuine later FVG is not sufficient evidence that the internal rebalance is protected or that opposite-side daily delivery is active.
The rule did not preserve one economic meaning across testbeds: 2022 passive BTC was strongly negative while ETH was locally positive, and the confirmed action was negative in both.
The missing information is direct ownership, sponsorship and acceptance of the post-raid inventory state, not another chart threshold.
decision: Retire the exact prior-day raid/reclaim -> genuine 5m FVG midpoint -> opposite prior-day boundary implementation.
Do not rescue it with symbol/side exceptions, FVG/pivot/session thresholds, target, stop, cost, risk, leverage or ML.
The broader scale-matched-liquidity principle remains a hypothesis; this result rejects chart geometry alone as proof of secured inventory and intended delivery.
